instruction.text: Listen to the poem and choose the words that rhyme.

atoms.b:
My skateboard takes me far ((away)),
sometimes, even through the ((hallway)).
atoms.sound: My skateboard takes me far away, sometimes even through the hallway

atoms.b:
I place my feet atop the ((board)),
and my good mood is ((restored)).
atoms.sound: I place my feet atop the board, and my good mood is restored

atoms.b:
With my board I find my ((speed)),
what more could I possibly ((need))?
atoms.sound: With my board I find my speed, what more could I possibly need?

atoms.b:
Is there anything more ((fun)),
than riding in the ((sun))?
atoms.sound: Is there anything more fun, than riding in the sun?

instruction.text: Listen to the poem and choose the words that rhyme.

atoms.b:
My dog runs around the ((yard)),
As if he is always on ((guard)).
atoms.sound: My dog runs around the yard, as if he is always on guard.
He runs and barks and loves all parks.

atoms.b:
I love him very ((much)),
He’s just so soft to ((touch)).
atoms.sound: I love him very much, he’s just so soft to touch.

atoms.b:
My little dog ((West)),
He is simply the ((best)).
atoms.sound: My little Dog West, he is simply the Best.
